## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and any important tradeoffs.

## Validation

- [ ] Build passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Format checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, configuration, or APIs changed.
- [ ] New or changed endpoints are documented.
- [ ] Configuration values and secrets are not committed.
- [ ] EF migrations are reviewed when the database model changed.
- [ ] The MVP smoke test was run, or the reason it was skipped is recorded below.
- [ ] No raw API keys or other secrets appear in logs, documentation, fixtures, or tests.

## Smoke test notes

State what was run and the result, or explain why a live smoke test was not applicable.

## Migration and rollout notes

Describe data migration, compatibility, rollback, or operational considerations. Write “None” when not applicable.
